tools.name: base_erc20_balance
tools.description: ERC-20 token balance of a wallet address on Base mainnet (USDC, WETH, any token): raw units, decimals, symbol and formatted amount, read live via eth_call.

tools.name: base_token_facts
tools.description: Verifiable on-chain facts about an ERC-20 token on Base: name, symbol, supply, whether the contract has an owner (and whether it was renounced), whether it is an upgradeable proxy and who administers it, whether it is paused, and which privileged functions (mint, burn, pause, blacklist, fee setting,

tools.name: base_token_info
tools.description: Basic facts about an ERC-20 token contract on Base mainnet: name, symbol, decimals and total supply (raw and formatted), read live via eth_call. Facts only, no price or recommendation.

tools.name: base_transaction
tools.description: Look up a transaction on Base by hash: success or revert, block and time, sender, recipient, ETH value, gas and fee, the called method selector, and decoded ERC-20 transfers with token symbols. Read live from the chain; facts only.

tools.name: base_wallet_balances
tools.description: ETH balance and balances of major tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, DAI, USDbC, cbETH, AERO) for any address on Base, plus any extra token contracts you list. Read live from the chain. Shows only non-zero balances; there is no price data and no recommendation.

tools.name: disposable_email_check
tools.description: Fast email address check without sending anything: syntax, domain MX records, disposable/temporary-mail domain (9,000+ listed), role address (info@, admin@) and likely typo of a popular provider. Does not confirm that a mailbox exists.

tools.name: dk_co2_intensity
tools.description: CO2 emissions per kWh of electricity consumed in Denmark (DK1 West, DK2 East), latest 5-minute value plus 24-hour average, cleanest and dirtiest times.

tools.name: dk_electricity_prices
tools.description: Day-ahead electricity spot prices for one day and bidding area, in EUR and DKK per MWh, quarter-hourly or hourly, with min/max/average and the cheapest hours. Tomorrow's prices are normally published around 13:00 CET.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Resolve public DNS records for a domain (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME) and report whether SPF and DMARC records are present, with their policies. DNS queries only; no connection is made to the domain itself.

tools.name: doi_lookup
tools.description: Scholarly metadata by DOI, or a best-match search by citation text: title, authors, journal, year, publisher, citation count, licence links and URL. Bibliographic facts only.

tools.name: domain_rdap
tools.description: Look up a domain in the public RDAP registry: registration, last-changed and expiry dates, status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC flag and registrar name. Registrant and contact details are not returned.

tools.name: ecb_key_rates
tools.description: The three ECB key interest rates with their latest change dates and recent history. Data only, not advice.

tools.name: ens_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name (e.g. vitalik.eth) to its Ethereum address, or look up the reverse-record name of an address, via the ENS registry on Ethereum mainnet. Onchain resolvers only; off-chain (CCIP-read) names report resolved=false.

tools.name: eu_vat_validate
tools.description: Check whether an EU VAT number is valid and active. Returns validity, registered name and address where the member state publishes them.

tools.name: fx_rate_ecb
tools.description: European Central Bank euro foreign-exchange reference rates for any date since 1999, converted to any base currency. Reference rates published around 16:00 CET on working days; not tradable quotes.

tools.name: iban_validate
tools.description: Validate an IBAN offline: ISO 13616 checksum (mod 97), registered length for the country, and a normalised and grouped format. Does not check that the account exists.

tools.name: lei_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) record by 20-character LEI, or search legal entities by name and country. Returns legal name, registry number, legal form, addresses and LEI registration status. Company-level data only.

tools.name: nordic_company_lookup
tools.description: Look up companies in the Norwegian and Finnish company registers by registration number or name: name, legal form, industry, address, registration date and status. Company-level data only, no persons.

tools.name: package_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Check an npm or PyPI package version against a public vulnerability database: advisory ids, aliases (CVE, GHSA), summary, severity label and first fixed version, plus the latest published version. Informational; not a full security audit.

tools.name: rss_feed_normaliser
tools.description: Turn any RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0, Atom or JSON Feed into one clean JSON schema: feed title, link and language, then items with id, title, URL, ISO published/updated dates, summary, categories and enclosure. Give a feed URL or a normal web page and the feed is discovered from its link tags. Author names are

tools.name: sitemap_robots_doctor
tools.description: Audit a website's robots.txt and XML sitemaps in one call: user-agent groups and blocked paths, sitemap declarations, whether each sitemap loads, URL counts (indexes followed to 10 files), lastmod coverage and age, duplicates, off-host and non-HTTPS URLs, size-limit breaches, and a sample of listed

tools.name: solana_swap_quote
tools.description: Get a swap quote on Solana through a DEX aggregator: expected output, minimum output after slippage, price impact, route venues and all fees in basis points. Read-only; nothing is signed or sent. Not investment advice.

tools.name: solana_swap_transaction
tools.description: Build an unsigned Solana swap transaction through a DEX aggregator for a wallet you control. The response contains the base64 transaction, the quote and every fee in basis points, including any integrator fee. Non-custodial: you sign locally, we never see keys or funds and do not send transactions.

tools.name: solana_token_facts
tools.description: Verifiable on-chain facts about a Solana token mint: whether the mint and freeze authorities are still set, total supply, decimals, token program, and how much of the supply the largest token accounts hold, plus public market metrics from a token index. Facts only: no verdict and no recommendation.

tools.name: solana_token_price
tools.description: Current USD price, 24-hour change, liquidity and decimals for up to 50 Solana token mints in one call, from an aggregated market feed. Unknown or unpriced mints are listed as null. Data only, not a recommendation.

tools.name: solana_token_search
tools.description: Find Solana tokens by symbol, name or mint address: mint, decimals, verification flag, organic score, liquidity, market cap and holder count. Facts and public metrics only; a high score is not a recommendation. Always check the mint address yourself because many tokens share symbols.

tools.name: solana_transaction
tools.description: Look up a confirmed Solana transaction by signature: success or error, time, fee, signers, programs used, and the resulting SOL and token balance changes per account. Public on-chain data; not advice.

tools.name: solana_wallet_balances
tools.description: SOL balance and token holdings of any Solana address, with symbols, USD prices and values, largest first. Sums multiple accounts of the same token and includes Token-2022 tokens. Public on-chain data and market prices; not advice. Very large wallets are limited to the most valuable holdings.

tools.name: ted_notices_search
tools.description: Find recent EU public procurement notices by buyer country, CPV code, keyword and notice type. Returns title, buyer organisation, CPV codes, deadline, estimated value and a link. Buyer organisations only, no contact persons. Run it on a schedule with publishedSince to get new tenders.

tools.name: url_metadata
tools.description: Link-preview data for one or many public URLs: title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph and Twitter card fields, favicon, language, hreflang alternates, feed links and JSON-LD types. Respects robots.txt, refuses private addresses, no JavaScript rendering. Each page is one result; failed pages a

tools.name: url_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its main text as Markdown with title, headings, lists, tables and absolute links. Respects robots.txt, refuses private and internal addresses, no JavaScript rendering. For pages that need a browser, use a rendering tool.

tools.name: us_treasury_rates
tools.description: Monthly average interest rates on US Treasury marketable securities (bills, notes, bonds, TIPS, FRNs) Latest months first. Data only, not advice.

tools.name: wikipedia_summary
tools.description: Lead-section summary of a Wikipedia article by title and language: plain-text extract, short description, canonical URL and last-edit time. Text is CC BY-SA 4.0 from Wikipedia contributors and must be attributed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: disposable_email_check, doi_lookup, sitemap_robots_doctor, url_metadata, url_to_markdown · Private data: base_erc20_balance, base_token_facts, base_token_info, base_transaction, base_wallet_balances, disposable_email_check, dns_lookup, domain_rdap, ens_resolve, lei_lookup, package_vulnerabilities, sitemap_robots_doctor, solana_swap_transaction, solana_token_facts, solana_token_price, solana_token_search, solana_transaction, solana_wallet_balances, ted_notices_search, url_metadata, url_to_markdown · Public sink: disposable_email_check, solana_swap_transaction, solana_token_search · Destructive: iban_validate, ted_notices_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: disposable_email_check, doi_lookup, sitemap_robots_doctor, url_metadata, url_to_markdown · Private data: base_erc20_balance, base_token_facts, base_token_info, base_transaction, base_wallet_balances, disposable_email_check, dns_lookup, domain_rdap, ens_resolve, lei_lookup, package_vulnerabilities, sitemap_robots_doctor, solana_swap_transaction, solana_token_facts, solana_token_price, solana_token_search, solana_transaction, solana_wallet_balances, ted_notices_search, url_metadata, url_to_markdown · Public sink: disposable_email_check, solana_swap_transaction, solana_token_search · Destructive: iban_validate, ted_notices_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
